Q1.question: 1.Does MA2 only serve large-sized companies?
Q1.answer: No, MA2 was created to be a strategic partner for small and medium-sized companies. But we are also chosen by big brands.

Q2.question: 2.Can I only hire MA2 services?
Q2.answer: For sure! Therefore, we have our complete portfolio to meet the specific needs of each business.

Q3.question: 3.What is communication outsourcing?
Q3.answer: It is the most updated communication and marketing model to deliver to your company what it needs in these disciplines. We have a multidisciplinary and strategic team to develop each of the stages and activities.

Q4.question: 4.Is my project personalized?
Q4.answer: 100% made for your business. Our team understands your structure and objectives to create a structured and phased program, monitoring each moment in a strategic and precise way.

Q5.question: 5.Does MA2 only serve Brazil?
Q5.answer: No, MA2 is a global company. We are headquartered in Brazil (São Paulo) and Germany (Lübeck), with operations beyond these countries, in Latin America, the US and many others.

description.title: The operational communications and marketing team
description.subtitle: Communication Outsourcing
description.text:
NetSafe Corp is a company that has been operating in the information security segment for 25 years.

MA2 is responsible for the structure of the communications and marketing team on all fronts, working close with the marketing and relationship director.

We build and expand all communication channels, such as social networks, e-book, blog, PR, newsletter and e-mail marketing, we structure internal communication and support all events and actions carried out by the company.

description.title: Brand redesign and update
description.subtitle: Website & Outsourcing
description.text:
Acura Capital is an investment manager focused on high-income and risk investors. Together with the board of directors, MA2 works to rebuild the brand to communicate with the market the way it operates and delivers its products: sophistication, excellence and pioneering spirit.

We are responsible for developing a website with an exclusive layout, made exclusively by our team, and for structuring the communication channels (social networks, blog, PR and newsletter) for the brand to communicate effectively.

description.title: Reinforce and communicate
description.subtitle: PR
description.text:
Grupo Impacta Tecnologia has been training professionals for the technology market for 35 years. With courses ranging from technologist and undergraduate, to postgraduate, MBA and corporate, being one of the main and most recognized in the country.

To communicate institutional actions and highlight the brand through Public Relations (PR), MA2 works together with the board and Marketing, to bring relevant agendas to the market.

description.title: Production for platforms
description.subtitle: Content
description.text:
ONCLICK is an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) focused on retail. In order to reach its audience, one of the main Marketing strategies is Content Marketing. And it is in this discipline that MA2 is the strategic partner.

The content team works from preparing the planning of monthly themes to producing specific and personalized content for the blog and e-books (content and art).

description.title: International communication
description.subtitle: Content & Translation
description.text:
SECUREWAY is a corporate security and infrastructure company. As part of the Marketing restructuring, content is a fundamental pillar of the strategy. As a result, MA2 is the partner responsible for producing weekly blog posts.

Additionally, we rewrote the entire website for launch alongside the rebranding in 2022 and are now translating it into English and Spanish as part of the brand's internationalization strategy.

description.title: New communication for the new brand
description.subtitle: Social Media & CI
description.text:
Neocount is the new brand of SW Contabilidade, which has been operating in the Espírito Santo market for more than 3 decades. After the rebranding, MA2 was chosen as the strategic partner to develop the website and the entire communication structure.

We are responsible for communication on social networks with the production of planning, content and images, blog posts, communications for customers and communication with internal teams, reinforcing the brand culture, which is very present at Neocount.

about.title: We are strategic, tireless and multidisciplinary.
about.subtitle: About MA2
about.p1: We combine communication and design with market intelligence and technology to create a new business model: communication outsourcing.
about.p2: Our DNA of innovation and excellence provides the necessary fuel to structure the on and offline communication of bold companies with the ambition to grow. Our main purpose is for brands to obtain results from their assertive tone of voice in national and international markets.
about.p3: In order to achieve this, we combine managerial, strategic and operational actions with innovation changes happening in the world and technological advances, so that companies are prepared to anticipate trends in their segments with authority and relevance.

why.title: Why MA2?
why.text: We are the marketing and communications team to position brands with an assertive tone of voice in their operating segments in Brazil and all around the world.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Being the corporate voice with excellence and assertiveness so that brands can communicate with their target market, investors and talents.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To be the largest reference in communication outsourcing for companies, regardless of whether they are in Brazil or in the process of internationalization, as well as for international companies that wants to expand to Brazil, generating tangible results through most of the communication and marketing disciplines.
